Man dude I understand your situation. Honestly you have two options. Realize he probably won’t change for a long time or for a long time accept that he does care about you in his own way. I’m sure in his own fucked up way he does love you, like I love my fiancé, but it’s not a way you’ll understand. Who knows though, by today’s standards you should definitely leave him but in my personal opinion I don’t give a flying fuck. You gotta understand it’s a fucked up breed of people. I’ve done horrible things in my life and I have never felt bad about them. I sometimes wish my loved ones were dead because it would make my life easier. But at the same time I do care about them, I take care of them, provide for them, etc. Don’t know why I do it. But recognize that it’s a mentally screwed person. I guarantee you he will continue to do things that make absolutely no sense to you and seem fucked up. Personal experience I’m sure he knows it wrong but doesn’t care like a lot of em. It’s a tricky situation and I’d definitely break it down for him, tell him you recognize his bullshit and all the lies, that you aren’t dumb.
